description: Dedicated HGRApi tool for POST api/ChannelListing/OptimizeImage. This is an explicit tool with a fixed endpoint; it is not a generic endpoint caller. Main fields: ImageUrl: string, Action: AIActionType, Settings: Setting[]. Header channel: current ChannelOAuthId. Output: Returns the result or applies the effect of the optimize image operation.
